rules_text:
Rules summary The Game Round - All players play simultaneously. - Each turn (day), players select one Information card and one Action card and place them face down. After revealing, they execute their actions: Download: Reveal and place the Information card in your play area. Encrypt: Place the Information card face down in your play area. Send (Left or Right): Reveal and place the Information card in the player’s play area to your left or right, respectively. - Players pass remaining Information cards to the next player (clockwise/counterclockwise based on the week). - The week ends after all Action cards are used. Last card in hand is discarded. Archiving Information - Reveal all Encrypted cards. - Compare relevance points of Information cards for each corporation. - First-place player archives the top Corporation card; second-place player takes the Key card. - If a tie occurs, the player with the Key decides the winner. End of the Game - The game ends after three weeks. - All remaining Information cards are archived. - Players gather archived cards, activating corporations with an Activator (any Corporation card or Worker). - Score based on activated cards and Key cards (1 point each). - The player with the highest reputation points wins. Tiebreakers are the number of activated corporations, then Key cards, and finally sharing the victory.
